body: The van keys and first-aid kit share one cord. Green field flecks mark the keys; a strip of road tape seals the kit.
title: van keys tied to a first-aid kit

body: A coil of rope cut into equal lengths, work gloves, and a measuring tape stopped at the same mark each time. Somebody was measuring out a perimeter around the vans, not a camp.
title: Rope and gloves from a roadside perimeter
